scripts.build:frontend: rm -rf public/dist && html-minifier-terser --input-dir public/frontend --output-dir public/dist --file-ext html --collapse-whitespace --remove-comments --minify-css true --minify-js true && find public/dist -name '*.html' -exec sed -i 's|<base href="[^"]*"|<base href="/"|' {} + && esbuild "public/frontend/src/**/*.js" "public/frontend/src/**/*.css" --minify --outdir=public/dist/src --outbase=public/frontend/src && cp -r public/frontend/src/assets public/dist/src/assets
